rules.name: The Single Dark Theme Rule
rules.body: Keep the renderer in its implemented dark-only state; do not add an unimplemented light theme or theme switch (index.html:2; styles.css:3-4, 28).

dos: Do preserve the single .dark renderer theme and color-scheme: dark (index.html:2; styles.css:3-4, 28).
Do preserve the 100vh shell/aside, fixed lower-right job dock, and 360px job-open content bottom inset (styles.css:119-140, 248-249; monitoring-9.tsx:168-172).
Do use the CSS-defined --vn-* palette and cite selector/token sources when extending it (styles.css:31-49).
Do retain the Chinese-only interface and current system font fallbacks (index.html:2; app-shell-1.tsx:8-14; styles.css:6-10).
donts: Don't invent light/dark or language switches; neither is implemented (index.html:2; app-shell-1.tsx:8-14).
Don't claim tested contrast ratios: no contrast measurements or guarantees are present in the inspected source (styles.css:31-49).
Don't make the job dock participate in shell sizing or remove its content safety inset (styles.css:124-129, 248-249; monitoring-9.tsx:168-172).

Don't claim that interaction animations are limited to :focus-visible: existing CSS includes nav/button/dropzone hover transitions, progress movement, toast entrance, and aurora drift (styles.css:88-117, 171-195, 295-314, 382-395, 559-570, 672-696). This is an observed mismatch with the requested interaction-motion constraint, not a new motion prescription.

components.name: Base Button
components.description: Base appearance from .vn-btn; default variant is outlined translucent, with a 0.18s hover state (styles.css:295-314).
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 9px 16px; border-radius: 11px; border: 1px solid var(--vn-line2); background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04); color: var(--vn-fg); font: 13px var(--font-sans); cursor: pointer; transition: 0.18s; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-btn:hover { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.09); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.6); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Violet call-to-action variant, matched to the implemented .vn-btn.primary (styles.css:320-329).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 9px 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 11px; background: #7c3aed; color: #fff; font: 600 13px var(--font-sans); cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgba(124, 58, 237, 0.25); transition: 0.18s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #6d28d9; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.6); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Navigation Item
components.description: Vertical side-rail navigation item with muted idle state and violet/cyan active state (styles.css:171-195).
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 9px 11px; border: 0; border-radius: 11px; background: transparent; color: var(--vn-muted); font: 14px var(--font-sans); cursor: pointer; transition: 0.18s; } .ds-nav:hover { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05); color: var(--vn-fg); } .ds-nav:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.6); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-nav[aria-current=page] { background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.22), rgba(34, 211, 238, 0.07)); color: #fff; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.35); }

components.name: Tag
components.css: .ds-tag { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 3px 9px; border: 1px solid var(--vn-line); border-radius: 99px; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03); color: var(--vn-muted); font: 11px var(--font-sans); line-height: 1.4; white-space: nowrap; flex-shrink: 0; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Translucent glass panel with fine border, blur and 18px corners matching .vn-card (styles.css:273-278).
components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--vn-panel); border: 1px solid var(--vn-line); border-radius: 18px; backdrop-filter: blur(16px); }

components.name: Job Dock
components.description: Fixed lower-right job progress card that overlays the shell (monitoring-9.tsx:168-172).
components.html: <aside class="ds-job-dock" aria-label="任务进度">任务进度</aside>
components.css: .ds-job-dock { position: fixed; right: 1rem; bottom: 1rem; z-index: 40; width: 440px; max-width: calc(100vw - 2rem); padding: 1rem; background: var(--vn-panel); border: 1px solid var(--vn-line); border-radius: 18px; backdrop-filter: blur(16px); }
